items.item: The verdict: dated tickets, not an annual pass
items.detail: Pearl breaks even at about 3.6 visits and Diamond needs roughly eleven. At three park days tickets win by Y299; at four including Sunday they win by ~Y348 because Pearl is weekdays-only and can't cover the Sunday at all. The only shape where Pearl wins is four all-weekday days, and only by ~Y125 — which the ticket-only add-on pricing then takes back. Buy dated tickets unless you know you'll spend ~Y1,500 on tenth-anniversary merchandise, or you're coming back inside a year.

items.item: Plan B — three park days plus a city day (recommended)
items.detail: City day Sunday 11 Oct, park Monday 12 – Wednesday 14, optional half-day Thursday 15 (+Y475, making it ~Y1,724). Every park day is a cheap weekday, the city gets a real day rather than scraps, and the Sunday crowd is somebody else's problem.

Sunday 11 through Wednesday 14. The Sunday is the one day worth adding Early Park Entry to — weekend crowds, and the only weekend day you'd see. Trade-off: you will not see Shanghai. Given Peter Pan's Flight here is widely held to be the best version in the world and it's the tenth-anniversary year, that may be exactly the right trade.

Observed October ladder: Y475 base for ordinary Tue/Wed, Y499 Sun/Mon/Thu, Y539 Fridays, Y599 Saturdays, Y629–659 pre-holiday 26–30 Sep, Y719–799 during Golden Week 1–5 Oct, then straight back to Y475 on 8 Oct. Your window sits in the calm right after the storm: expect Y499 for Sun 11 and Mon 12, Y475 for Tue 13 and Wed 14.
Book 10+ days ahead and it saves Y50; the Y445 variant at 30 days adds a Y30 dining coupon. Your buy window IS 30 days, so this is free money if you book the day a date opens.
About 10% off two separate 1-days, currently Y749 on a limited-time promo, Y798 as an Early Bird 2-Day. The best way to buy consecutive days.

Buy one get one free. One pairing is TRON + Peter Pan, the other Zootopia + Winnie the Pooh — about Y180 for two skips against Y140–180 each à la carte. The interesting bundle, largely because of Peter Pan.

Up to an hour before public opening, ~Y179 premium over a base ticket. This is the resort-hotel perk sold separately — which is why five nights at Toy Story to get it once makes no sense for a solo traveller.

Reserved viewing for three new shows plus a Y100 F&B coupon. Steep, but it's the anniversary year and the shows are the reason. The celebration runs all year as 'With You, It's Magic+': new castle show The Heart of Magic, an updated Mickey's Storybook Express parade, and an anniversary finale added to ILLUMINATE!

Every ticket is real-name registered: buy with your passport number and carry that passport. Official site, app, WeChat account or the official Fliggy store — foreign Visa and Mastercard work. Klook or Trip.com are the fallback for admission only if the official checkout throws the Chinese-SMS wall; check the partner is on Disney's own channels page. Premier Access is sold through the four official channels only, no reseller. Foreign passport holders must activate an annual pass in person at Main Entrance Guest Services — another reason not to buy one.

items.item: In the park: rope drop is the whole game
items.detail: First hour: Zootopia: Hot Pursuit, then TRON Lightcycle Power Run — the two that build 60–90 minute lines by mid-morning and stay there. Second: Pirates of the Caribbean – Battle for the Sunken Treasure, the single best thing in the park and not close, then Soaring Over the Horizon. Plan around Peter Pan's Flight rather than dropping into it. On post-Golden-Week weekdays you shouldn't need Premier Access at all — walk in, read the standby boards, buy a single pass only if a wait crosses an hour. ILLUMINATE closes the park and the metro floods immediately; from the Courtyard you can just walk.
